text: SRMJEEE 2026 is a national exam conducted by SRMIST as the common entrance for B.Tech and M.Tech at all SRM Group institutions: Kattankulathur, Ramapuram, Vadapalani, Delhi-NCR (Ghaziabad), Amaravati, Sonepat (Haryana) and Sikkim. Campus and course are allotted at counselling purely on SRMJEEE All India Rank, seat availability and your choice preferences.

B.Tech eligibility (2026-27): resident Indian, at least 16 years 6 months old on 31 July of the year of the 12th board exam; passed or appearing in 10+2 with minimum 60% aggregate in 3 subjects - Physics and Mathematics are mandatory plus one of Chemistry, Biotechnology, Biology, Computer Science, IT, Informatics Practices, Engineering Graphics, Botany and Zoology. Boards accepted: any Indian board, CBSE, ISCE, IB or NIOS. NRI, PIO and OCI applicants must use the international application form.

SRMJEEE 2026 exam pattern: Remote Proctored Online Mode (from home on a desktop or laptop with a webcam; mobile phones are not allowed). 2 hours 30 minutes, 130 multiple-choice questions in English: Physics 35, Chemistry 35, Mathematics/Biology 40, English and Aptitude 20. Marking is +1 per correct answer and no negative marking, so attempt every question.

How to apply for SRMJEEE: register at applications.srmist.edu.in/btech with basic details (email verification), complete the form, upload a photograph and signature (JPEG), choose the exam phase and pay the Rs. 1,400 fee online (debit/credit card, UPI or net banking). Submit a separate application for each phase you want to attempt. The course/campus preference at this stage is for statistics only; real choices are made at counselling. If payment shows pending wait 24 hours.

Slot booking opens about 2-3 days before each phase's exam dates, two slots per day, first-come-first-served, and a booked slot cannot be changed. The admit card is available immediately after slot booking on the admission portal (login with application number and date of birth). Carry a valid photo ID (Aadhaar, PAN, passport, driving licence or school ID). An official mock test is available before the exam.

Counselling for SRMJEEE is online and held separately after each phase's results: check your All India Rank, fill campus/programme choices, get a seat allotment based on rank and availability, then pay Rs. 1,10,000 (registration Rs. 10,000 + counselling Rs. 1,00,000) within the stipulated time to get the provisional allotment letter. Non-payment cancels the allotment. Fees other than the registration fee are refundable as per AICTE norms.

SRMIST offers scholarships with fee waivers from 25% to 100% depending on SRMJEEE rank and Class 12 percentage; attending SRMJEEE counselling is mandatory to receive a scholarship. Direct admission and scholarships are also offered to first-rank students of central and state boards, top 10,000 IIT-JEE rankers, top rankers of each Tamil Nadu district and exemplary national/international sportspersons. Details: https://www.srmist.edu.in/admission-india/engineering/scholarships/

SRMJEEE FAQs: you may attempt multiple phases but it is not mandatory to appear in all; there is no negative marking; at application only a photograph and signature are needed (other documents at counselling); results are online using application number and date of birth; computer expertise beyond basic mouse/keyboard use is not needed; classes typically begin in August. The exam needs a webcam-enabled laptop/desktop, Chrome or Firefox, about 2 Mbps internet, microphone and headphones.

Admission helplines: Engineering, Agriculture and Architecture admissions +91 70 2645 2645. Liberal Arts and Business Studies (formerly Science and Humanities), Law, Management, Medical and Allied Health Sciences and Hotel Management admissions +91 70 2647 2647. General switchboard +91-44-27417000 / +91-44-27417777.

Programme entry routes at Engineering & Technology: B.Tech via SRMJEEE (UG); M.Tech via SRMJEEE (PG); B.Arch via NATA; PG Diploma in Genetic Counselling via GCEE; B.Des and M.Arch are admitted on qualifying-exam marks (M.Arch also has a written test and interview). M.Tech candidates need a relevant B.E./B.Tech (or equivalent) with a minimum 50% aggregate; exact feeder branches differ per M.Tech specialisation.

At the Kattankulathur campus there are 14 hostel blocks for men (capacity 200-1000 each, about 7,500 in total), 7 blocks for women (250-700 each, about 4,000 in total) and a separate International Hostel. Students can choose North Indian or South Indian menus in the co-located dining halls at subsidised rates; the international hostel mess also offers Thai, Chinese and continental food. Gym, playground and indoor games are available.

Hostel booking is online only via the student portal https://sp.srmist.edu.in. First-year students become eligible once admission formalities are complete and they hold a Net ID and password; booking schedules are circulated by year of study (1st year B.Tech/M.Tech, PG, B.Arch/B.Des, 2nd, 3rd, 4th-5th year, research scholars) as PDFs on the hostels page. No student may stay in the hostel without formal admission, and every student signs an undertaking to follow the hostel rules.

Hostel eligibility: full-time bonafide UG, PG and research students of Engineering & Technology, Medicine and Health Sciences, Science & Humanities, Management and Law, and full-time diploma students of Polytechnic and Hotel Management. Not eligible: students who failed and were not re-admitted, part-time/evening/correspondence students, students penalised for indiscipline, and working persons or ex-students.

Hostel helpdesk (KTR): hostel.helpdesk.ktr@srmist.edu.in, mobile 8056016602, accounts office 044-27434507, hostel office 044-27453159. Director (Hostels): Dr. E. Poovammal, director.hostels@srmist.edu.in, +91 9940036021. Hostel rules are published as a PDF on the hostels page.

SRMIST placement tiers: Marquee companies (Rs. 20 lakh+ per annum) include Wells Fargo, Adobe, Morgan Stanley, Atlassian, PayPal, Cisco, BNY Mellon, Nutanix, Google India, Amazon, Arista Networks and Commvault. Super Dream companies (Rs. 10 lakh+) include Google, Microsoft, Optum, Honda, Barclays, ZS Associates and VMware. Dream companies (Rs. 5 lakh+) include Deloitte, Capgemini, Siemens, KPMG, L&T, TCS, Cognizant, Infosys and Wipro.

Placement milestones published by SRMIST: 600 companies made 6,777 offers in 2018-19; for the 2020 batch the Day-1 recruiters (TCS, Cognizant, Infosys, Wipro) made a record 4,751 offers and 7,926 offers had been made by 24 Jan 2020; 200+ new recruiters in a year; highest package 41.6 LPA by Microsoft. These are SRMIST's own published figures from its Placements page and may not reflect the latest year. SRMIST is also a nodal centre for the three services of the Indian Armed Forces.
